chapters.reason: The paper proposes Soft Reasoning, which uses embedding perturbation (adding controlled noise) and Bayesian optimization to refine continuous token embeddings for guided generation, aligning with the description of embedding-based diffusion models that operate on continuous embeddings with noise corruption and denoising for controllable generation.

Soft Reasoning integrates embedding exploration with autoregressive generation, using a verifier-guided objective to refine embeddings during inference, which combines aspects of diffusion-like refinement with sequential autoregressive generation, fitting the hybrid AR-diffusion paradigm that blends both approaches for improved reasoning.

The framework aims to enhance complex reasoning in LLMs by navigating solution spaces, improving multi-step reasoning accuracy and coherence, which relates to applications requiring structured, multi-step logical inference as described in this category.
